description: Real-time Voice & Multi-Agent Collaboration Web Interface wrapping Hermes

features.name: Full-Duplex Hermes WebSocket Gateway
features.description: Establish and maintain a resilient bi-directional WebSocket connection with Hermes agent server (including auto-reconnect and heartbeat ping/pong).

features.name: Bi-directional Real-time Voice Streaming
features.description: Microphone audio capture via Web Audio API / AudioWorklet, streaming to backend, and low-latency audio chunk playback with barge-in / interruption support.

features.name: Central Voice Orb & Satellite Subagent Orbs
features.description: Central ambient reactive voice visualizer for the main agent with dynamic satellite orbs spawned per active subagent reflecting their real-time state (idle, thinking, active, done).

features.name: 3-Pane Swappable Layout Architecture
features.description: A 3-pane layout containing Left (Chat Transcripts), Middle (Central & Satellite Orbs), and Right (Multi-Agent Task Tree & Execution Logs) with support for panel swapping and collapsing.

features.name: Real-Time Streaming Chat Transcript
features.description: Live streaming markdown rendering for agent replies, user speech transcription, timestamping, code block highlighting, and inline tool execution chips.

features.name: Multi-Agent Task Tree & Parallel Logs
features.description: Hierarchical display of dispatched subagent tasks, live progress bars, status indicators, stdout/stderr streams, and artifact outputs.

features.name: Deterministic Mock Hermes Server & Sandbox Replay
features.description: Mock WebSocket server replay engine using test-fixtures/seed-data.json for automated, deterministic headless testing without requiring physical microphone or live backend.
